data.description: After the contract calibration session, run the full contract test suite to verify all 13 fixed tests pass consistently. Command: python -m pytest tests/performance/contracts/ -v -m contract. Expected: ~300 passed, 12 skipped (2 impl bugs + 5 CDG classes with multiple tests). If any fixed tests fail intermittently, may need to increase threshold headroom further. Document final pass/skip counts in KT. This should be done before merging the branch.
data.title: Run full contract test suite verification
